spanish: Acercó su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun left as the untranslated lemma sólet
qal passive of mix is narrowed to kneaded (amasada)
מִנְחָה is a common noun left as the untranslated lemma minjá

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens, including hiphil acercó, weights, singular siclo, and en for ב.
